name: rupbar
description: RupBar — sistema de gestão para bares, adegas e tabacarias. by Ruptix

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @rupbar/local-ui build && pnpm --filter @rupbar/server bundle && pnpm --filter @rupbar/owner-panel build
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm --filter @rupbar/local-ui build && pnpm --filter @rupbar/server bundle && node tests/e2e/smoke.mjs && node tests/e2e/stock.mjs && node tests/e2e/recipes.mjs
scripts.build:installer: pnpm bundle:server && cargo build --release --manifest-path apps/service-host/Cargo.toml --config apps/service-host/.cargo/config.toml && pnpm --filter @rupbar/desktop build:installer
